notes.title: Temukung:Cultivation in Drylands:Opening
notes.content:
In Temukung:Cultivation in Drylands, there are 5 main ethnics:Atoni, Bunak, Helong, Kemak, and Tetun. However there are sub-ethnics based on regions with Aton with Atoni Bikomi and Atoni L based on dialects. In Tetun, there are Tetun Belu and Tetun Malaka based on region.

Atoni L is Atoni who have differrent accent with another Atoni with "R" word changed to "L" in every word. In Atoni, there are many sub-ethnics but Atoni L is another things based on their language. Most of Atoni L speaker lives in South Central Timor regancy and several.part of Malaka regancy. 
In opening Atoni L, the story similiar with Atoni Bikomi but they used south Atoni kingdoms like Amanuban and Amanatun who went to Mutis mountain with south route.

This is opening of Atoni L
[previewyoutube=dTs2b7X0vus;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Atoni Bikomi is one of kingdom in North Central Timor and part of Sonbai’s followers. This animation told the history of West Timor based on oral story of Atoni
[previewyoutube=f0i2K4ugoGg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Tetun Malaka is Tetun who lives in Malaka. Malaka is the most fertile land in West Timor and allows the cultivation cycle in twice on 1 year. Malaka is home where Liurai Wehali lives. He is the ruler of Malaka and Belu which consider as highest ruler of Timor under Maromak Oan, son of gods.

In opening Tetun Malaka, the story based on legand Sina Mutin Malaka, the story how Tetun come of Malaka from Malaka in Malaya with route Malaka to Makassar and Makassar to Laranruka. The story continue with Portuguese and Makassar in Wehali and after defeated by Portuguese.

This is the opening of Tetun Malaka
[previewyoutube=tkUvOyBCkKU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Like Tetun Malaka, Tetun Belu share similiar legand with Tetun Malaka, but their focus on Belu area.

This is the opening of Tetun Belu

[previewyoutube=I9OsO-hYErs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Bunak is ethnic live in Lamaknen area, the mountains area between Belu and Timor Portuguese

This is the opening of Bunak
[previewyoutube=HlxpF7Adic8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Helong is a native ethnic who lives in Kupang and Semau island. In their legand, they came from Maluku islands and settled in bay of Kupang. In Kupang, Dutch takeover king of Helong's fort and established fort of Concordia. In later, Kupang got attacked by Sonbai and Topases with host of mans, but they got defeated by Dutch and their allies. 


This is the opening of Helong
[previewyoutube=u8woE9dekuU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your attention.
